links.outcome: Performance differences across source and validation corpora, including suicidal-ideation sensitivity
links.effect: Validation corpus explained 29.4% of variance with no significant source-corpus effect; suicidal-ideation sensitivity was 0.80 on NSQIP vs 1.00 on VNS (largest model); macro F1 lower for smaller models and NSQIP.
links.quote: Macro F1-scores were lower than weighted F1-scores for smaller models and NSQIP; suicidal-ideation sensitivity was lower on NSQIP than VNS (0.80 vs 1.00, largest model), limiting generalization for psychiatric risk detection.

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates a 2-stage LLM pipeline to extract symptom severity trajectories from clinical notes without evaluating an operational deployment practice or guardrail.
